services.name: Weddings/Rental Space
services.desc: Built in the late 1800s, Miramont Castle is a treasured historic landmark filled with craftsmanship, artistry, and story. Hosting your event here invites guests into another era-rich with elegance, authenticity, and timeless charm. From intimate celebrations to grand gatherings, Miramont offers a distinctive setting for birthdays, anniversaries, corporate events, weddings, and private parties. With period details, warm ambiance, and architectural beauty throughout, every moment feels elevated-and unforgettable. services.name: Pikes Peak Hill Climb Exhibit
services.desc: The Broadmoor Pikes Peak International Hill Climb is the second oldest motor sports race in America and a long-standing tradition in Colorado Springs and the Pikes Peak Region. First competed in 1916, this year (2024) marks the 102nd running of the “Race to the Clouds.” As the drivers climb toward the summit, the thin air slows reflexes and saps muscle strength. The thin air also robs engines of 30% of their power at the summit. Competitors and vehicles must be in top shape simply to finish…let alone win! The performance of electrically powered vehicles is not affected by altitude changes. The current record is 07:57.148 and was set by Romain Dumas in 2018 driving an all-electric Volkswagen
